title: NTA's own experts leaked NEET-UG papers for cash, CBI chargesheet alleges
content: The CBI has filed a chargesheet naming thirteen individuals in a paper leak conspiracy.  NTA subject experts allegedly accessed and shared confidential examination questions illegally.  A chain of intermediaries then distributed these leaked papers to candidates for money.  Digital evidence confirms the circulation of leaked questions through messaging platforms.  The investigation uncovered a structured supply chain involving coaching operators and brokers.

title: Man yells at woman for sleeping on seat, whips out belt to hit her in Mumbai local
content: A viral video shows a man abusing and threatening a woman on a Mumbai local train.  The Andheri GRP is registering an FIR and attempting to locate the commuter.  Police identified the man using video and CCTV footage from railway stations.  This incident follows two previous murders on local trains over trivial disputes.  Authorities are confident of an imminent arrest in this disturbing case.

title: Elon Musk's preferred state halts data center approvals; says 'prove' this
content: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has ordered a temporary halt to new data center approvals.  Regulators must complete a comprehensive audit before projects can move forward.  Developers must prove electricity and water use, and tax incentives.  Abbott stated Texans must come first in all state decisions.  This move addresses growing scrutiny over rapid data center expansion.

title: Blunder! KL Rahul's dropped catch proves costly for India in Colombo - WATCH
content: KL Rahul had a forgettable moment on the field during India's warm-up match against Sri Lanka XI in Colombo. Leading the side in the absence of injured captain Shubman Gill, Rahul dropped a simple catch at first slip when Ravindu Rasantha was on 43. The Sri Lanka batter made the most of the lifeline and went on to score 71.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: After ten years of service, The Primary School, co-founded by Priscilla Chan, will conclude its operations in June. This institution, known for offering tuition-free education and extensive family support, struggled to achieve state-average academic results despite receiving generous funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. The Initiative has decided to redirect its philanthropic priorities towards funding scientific research instead.

title: 'Want to meet Suvendu babu': Man climbs lamp post, performs stunts for 40 minutes
content: In a startling incident, a man with mental challenges scaled a lamp post on Tala Bridge, triggering a significant traffic halt. His insistence on meeting chief minister Suvendu Adhikari raised urgent concerns. With police and rescue teams swiftly on the scene, the standoff lasted nearly forty minutes before the man was safely brought down and taken into custody for further questioning regarding his actions.

title: Widow returns medieval Glastonbury Abbey relic stolen 70 years ago
content: A medieval abbot's kneecap and a floor tile have been returned to Glastonbury Abbey more than 70 years after they were taken by an 11-year-old schoolboy during an archaeological dig. The artefacts were kept in Australia for decades before the boy's widow brought them back following his death in 2025.

title: Google warns Blackstone, Bridgewater, Bain, KKR, TPG, Moody’s of phone hack
content: Recent reports from Google reveal that hackers have set their sights on prominent US financial companies, employing cunning phone scams to extract sensitive credentials from employees. Following this, they launched customized malicious websites designed specifically for each target. Shifting their attention to private equity firms, these assailants have allegedly compelled some businesses to pay ransoms after committing data theft.

title: Abhijeet Dipke backs Jharkhand students' protest
content: Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, stands in solidarity with Jharkhand students who are protesting against exam irregularities. His party is actively providing meals and support to those participating in the demonstration, which has now entered its fourteenth day. The students are insisting on the cancellation of the JPSC Civil Services Examination and are calling for an independent investigation.

title: Duo murder labourer near Coimbatore, take selfies with body, post on social media
content: A 22-year-old labourer was murdered with weapons in Coimbatore district early Thursday.  Two youths, including a teenager, assaulted him and recorded the brutal act.  They shared the disturbing video and photos on a social media platform.  Police identified the suspects from the circulated footage and began their search.  The motive is believed to be a past warning given by the victim.

title: Pakistan cricketer banned for two years over misleading visa information
content: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has banned all-rounder Hamza Nazar from all forms of cricket for two years after finding that he provided misleading information during a visa application. The board also fined the youngster Rs 1 million, saying it takes cases of misrepresentation and non-disclosure very seriously. The decision was announced on Thursday following an internal inquiry.

title: Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce lawsuit takes major new turn in court
content: In a legal clash, 1587 Sneakers refutes claims made by Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes about their alleged control of the steakhouse. The sneaker company maintains that the NFL duo has been instrumental in promoting the establishment. This case hinges on the risk of consumer confusion with their branding strategy, as the steakhouse's name incorporates jersey numbers compared to the brand's historical meaning.

title: How Coco Gauff's parents sacrificed everything to build a Grand Slam champion
content: Coco Gauff’s rise to Grand Slam success is also the story of her family’s belief. Her parents changed their lives to support her dream, stayed by her side through pressure and celebrated every milestone with her. From Wimbledon at 15 to the 2023 US Open title, Gauff’s journey shows how faith, sacrifice and family can shape a champion.

title: Video: Andhra medical student dies after car driven by ‘drunk’ youth rams her scooty
content: In a tragic incident, two intoxicated young men crashed their vehicle into a scooty carrying medical students, resulting in one student being declared brain dead. The police have taken swift action, arresting Suravarapu Daswanth and Andrew Joseph Edwards. Prior to the crash, the pair had been refused entry to a mall due to their drunken state. Legal proceedings are now underway against the individuals for their reckless actions.

title: Watch: Passenger tries to open plane's emergency exit mid-air, held in Kochi
content: A passenger was arrested on a Kuala Lumpur-Kochi flight for trying to open an emergency exit. He damaged the window panel and caused panic among fellow passengers during the flight. Cabin crew and other passengers managed to restrain the man before further damage occurred. The aircraft landed safely at Cochin International Airport where authorities took him into custody.

title: Gold price prediction: Buy on dips the right strategy for gold right now?
content: MCX Gold October futures continue to trade with a positive bias as prices remain well supported above key moving averages despite witnessing intermittent profit booking. The overall trend remains constructive, with higher highs and higher lows indicating sustained buying interest.

title: 'Thudakkam' X review: Vismaya Mohanlal earns praise for debut
content: Jude Anthany Joseph's film 'Thudakkam' has opened in theaters with significant curiosity. Vismaya Mohanlal's acting debut in a prominent role has drawn early viewer attention. Ashish Joe Antony also made a strong impression in the film's opening portions. Early responses largely praise Vismaya's performance and the film's technical aspects. A special title card dedicated to Mohanlal has also attracted positive attention.

title: No train ticket alone can't defeat accident claim: Gujarat HC
content: The Gujarat high court ordered the Railways to pay compensation to a deceased man's family. The court set aside a tribunal's order which had rejected the family's compensation claim. The tribunal wrongly relied on police statements and ignored evidence supporting the family's case. The High Court found the Railways failed to prove the deceased lacked a valid ticket.

title: Prashant Kishor meets NCP chief Sunetra Pawar after bypoll win, BJP upset
content: Prashant Kishor met NCP leaders Sunetra and Parth Pawar after his recent election victory.  This meeting has caused significant displeasure among the allied BJP party members.  BJP leaders expressed concern over engaging a strategist known for opposing them.  The meeting occurred shortly after Kishor's win in a BJP stronghold constituency.  This marks the second such meeting between Kishor and the NCP leaders within three months.

title: 'Ask me anything': Rahul on Instagram reveals his favourite BJP leader
content: Rahul Gandhi launched an Instagram "Ask Me Anything" session for young people. He discussed the Jharkhand student protest and the nation's education system. Gandhi emphasized that governments must listen to student concerns and take action. He also spoke about supporting young women in all life spheres. The Congress leader engaged with GenZ on various topics and political matters.

title: Ashutosh Ranka education: IIT Kanpur to CJP co-convener journey
content: Ashutosh Ranka’s education journey reflects a blend of engineering, leadership and public policy. After completing his B.Tech in Materials Science and Engineering from IIT Kanpur, where he also served as Students’ Gymkhana President, he pursued a Master of Public Administration from the London School of Economics and Political Science. His academic experiences and corporate background at McKinsey shaped his analytical approach, later influencing his role as CJP Co-convener and strategist behind Cockroach Janta Party.

title: Jharkhand protest day 14: Student shifted to hospital after health worsens
content: A student on hunger strike was hospitalized as unrest continues over recruitment exam grievances. Six students are still protesting, demanding the cancellation of the JPSC Civil Services exam. Student organizations have announced a march towards the Jharkhand Assembly amidst its ongoing session. On Thursday, opposition legislators raised the issue within the Assembly. This student-led movement, which began on July 25, has been gaining considerable attention and support.

title: Nagpur rape accused in ICU, survivor battles scars in general ward of same hospital
content: A 19-year-old Thane youth was moved to the ICU after complaining of health issues. He is accused of holding a teenage girl captive and sexually torturing her. The survivor underwent plastic surgery for deep wounds inflicted by a surgical blade. Police are seeking cyber experts to unlock seized mobile phones for clues. The accused demanded VIP treatment and refused to cooperate with the investigation.

title: Scientists in China create a self-healing dress from living fungus
content: Researchers from China have created a groundbreaking living textile using Cordyceps militaris, a type of fungus. This material possesses remarkable self-repair abilities, capable of mending its own cuts while generating new surface layers. It incorporates engineered yeast for vibrant natural colors. A prototype dress showcasing these features was produced, and notably, this innovative fabric biodegrades entirely in just forty-one days.

title: 'Waves without quake': Mystery well in Gujarat baffles locals
content: In a remote village in Morbi district, Gujarat, an 18-foot-deep well has captivated locals with its swirling waves and ripples that have persisted for five days. Experts theorize that trapped air from underground rocks may be responsible for the unique phenomenon, while seismic activity has been dismissed by geologists. A specialized team from Gandhinagar is set to explore this intriguing scenario.

title: Agni-IV: Why the 4,000km nuclear-capable missile is essential for India
content: India successfully tested its Agni-IV ballistic missile, showcasing strategic readiness.  This road-mobile weapon enhances the country's response capabilities against any threat.  The Agni-IV missile incorporates advanced technologies for improved accuracy and survivability.  Its 4,000-kilometer range with a nuclear or conventional warhead offers strategic flexibility.  This test reinforces India's self-reliance and credible nuclear deterrence posture.

title: 'We are children, not terrorists': Jharkhand students on hunger strike
content: For two weeks now, protests have erupted over alleged irregularities in the Jharkhand recruitment exam. The situation is dire, as six students on hunger strike show signs of declining health. While two student factions prepare to march to the state Assembly, negotiations have stalled. The students insist on an audience with Chief Minister Hemant Soren and are demanding a CBI inquiry into the exams held during his administration.

title: McCullum vows to 'develop' Brook into England's next Test captain
content: Brendon McCullum endorses the decision to reappoint Joe Root as England's Test captain, expressing confidence in his leadership. He also hints that Harry Brook is destined to take on the captaincy role in the future. Meanwhile, Stephen Fleming has been named the new Test coach, expected to excel in guiding the squad, with Marcus Trescothick stepping in as interim coach until Fleming takes over.

title: Vijay vs Udhayanidhi: CM rejects DMK's all-party meet demand on Cauvery dispute
content: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay rejected an all-party meeting on the Mekedatu Dam. He asserted his government would not compromise on Cauvery water rights. The opposition leader demanded the meeting, citing concerns over water release. Vijay stated the state's position was already conveyed to the Prime Minister. He urged the opposition not to politicize the serious water dispute.

title: Watch: Accident victim's fractured leg tied with carton at Bihar Hospital
content: A victim of a road accident was treated in a startling manner at the Manjhaul Sub-Divisional Hospital, located in Begusarai, Bihar, where a medicine carton served as a splint. Hospital officials attributed this alarming method to insufficient resources and personnel. The incident gained significant online attention after a video surfaced, prompting a wave of indignation. Consequently, a civil surgeon's investigation into the reported medical malpractice has been initiated.

title: Newly elected PoK legislator is on police bail in UK for child sex offences
content: A former PoK minister faces child sex offense allegations from the 1990s.  He was arrested in the UK and is currently out on police bail.  Ahmed allegedly failed to attend a court date, campaigning instead in Mirpur.  A UK judge allowed him to travel to Pakistan despite his bail status.  Greater Manchester police may seek his extradition if he fails to appear.

title: How a 21-year-old solved a Rubik's Cube blindfolded in 11.56 seconds
content: Tommy Cherry, a 21-year-old American student, achieved a Guinness World Record by solving a 3×3×3 Rubik's Cube blindfolded in just 11.56 seconds. Starting as an 11-year-old hobbyist, Tommy transformed his curiosity into years of disciplined practice, multiple records and global recognition. His journey highlights the importance of consistency, memory training, resilience and self-improvement. Beyond competitions, he inspires students by showing that extraordinary achievements come from dedication, patience and continuous learning.

title: Watch: Fans used to dry up damaged portion of Rs 4,200cr Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway
content: A contractor is using fans to dry damaged sections of the Lucknow-Kanpur expressway.  This method was employed after heavy rains delayed repair work on the newly inaugurated road.  Photographs of the fans went viral, drawing criticism and public ridicule online.  The damaged stretch has caused significant traffic congestion and delays for commuters.  Authorities have directed the contractor to repair the damage at their own expense.

title: Shubman Gill suffers finger injury, KL Rahul leads India in warm-up game
content: During practice, Shubman Gill, India’s Test captain, suffered a finger injury, prompting the team to rest him on the first day of the warm-up match for safety. In his stead, KL Rahul is taking charge of the squad. With the Test series looming, there is growing concern about Gill's fitness, and the management is monitoring his recovery closely.

title: Trump’s Gaza Board moves ahead with first project - military base for Moroccan troops
content: a small military outpost intended to house Moroccan troops is set to become the first construction project pursued under US president Donald Trump’s board of peace in Gaza . the project comes as the board moves ahead with a more limited reconstruction programme for the territory . it is planned inside the 60% of Gaza currently under direct Israeli military control, about a mile from the Israeli border .
